name: ANTH 3050W
title: Anthropology of Jews and Jewishness
description: (Also offered as HEJS 3050W.) Survey of the rich and growing ethnographic literature on Jews and Jewishness around the globe. Course materials include ethnographic texts, music, and videos/films.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011. Recommended preparation: ANTH 1000 or 1006.
